description: This file defines a Java interface 'ProductImageRemove' that extends another interface 'ImageRemove'. It declares methods for removing product images either individually or in relation to a product within the sales management core module.

classes.name: ProductImageRemove
classes.description: A Java interface for removing product images, extending the ImageRemove interface.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a specific product image; may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a product; may throw ServiceException.
